Reactions

Reaction Context

Shared reaction state and context utilities.

class liiontr.reactions.context.ReactionContext[source]

Bases: object

Shared state available to coupled reactions.

Conversions are stored by reaction name.

Additional variables can be used for quantities such as SEI thickness, pressure, gas concentration, or other reaction-dependent state variables.

Context Variables

Derived variables evaluated from shared reaction contexts.

class liiontr.reactions.context_variable.ContextVariable[source]

Bases: ABC

Base class for variables derived from a ReactionContext.

Context variables are algebraic quantities computed from the current reaction state. They are not independent ODE states.

abstractmethod evaluate(context)[source]

Evaluate the variable from the current reaction context.

Parameters:

context (ReactionContext)

Return type:

float

class liiontr.reactions.context_variable.LinearConversionVariable[source]

Bases: ContextVariable

Variable derived linearly from a reaction conversion.

The relation is:

x = x_ref + slope * (alpha - alpha_ref)

class liiontr.reactions.context_variable.RemainingFractionRatioVariable[source]

Bases: ContextVariable

Ratio of the current remaining fraction to a reference value.

The relation is:

x = (1 - alpha) / c_ref

where alpha is the reaction conversion and c_ref is the reference remaining fraction.

Reaction Model Interface

Protocols and interfaces implemented by reaction models.

class liiontr.reactions.model.ReactionModel[source]

Bases: Protocol

Interface implemented by reaction models used in a ReactionNetwork.

A reaction model must expose a name and provide both a progress rate and a mass-specific heat generation rate.

progress_rate(temperature, conversion, context=None)[source]

Return the reaction conversion rate.

The reaction progress follows

\[\]

frac{dalpha}{dt} = k(T) f(alpha, mathrm{context}),

where \(k(T)\) is the temperature-dependent kinetic rate and \(f\) is the reaction-progress model.

Multi-Channel Reactions

Multi-channel thermal runaway reaction models.

class liiontr.reactions.multichannel.ReactionChannel[source]

Bases: object

One kinetic and thermal channel of a multichannel reaction.

Each channel has its own kinetic model and reaction enthalpy, but all channels share the same reaction progress variable.

__init__(kinetics, enthalpy)
Parameters:

Return type:

None

class liiontr.reactions.multichannel.MultiChannelReaction[source]

Bases: object

Chemical reaction composed of multiple parallel channels.

All channels share one conversion alpha and one progress model.

The reaction progress rate is:

d(alpha)/dt =

f(alpha, context) * sum(k_i(T))

The mass-specific heat generation rate is:

q_dot =

mass_fraction * f(alpha, context) * sum(H_i * k_i(T))

Validate the multi-channel reaction definition.

Return type:

None

Reaction Networks

Reaction-network orchestration for coupled thermal reactions.

class liiontr.reactions.network.ReactionNetwork[source]

Bases: object

Collection of chemical reaction models.

Reaction names must be unique because they are used as keys in the shared ReactionContext.

Both simple reactions and multichannel reactions can be used as long as they implement the ReactionModel protocol.
